derivation.source_identifier_note: The prompt arXiv:1610.03309 is unrelated; the correct Goto source is Sci. Rep. 6, 19578 (2016).
derivation.plus_derivation: Full Hadamard conjugation: swap R/RX and M/MX, reverse every CX. No extra H primitive or unsourced timing is introduced.
derivation.dangerous_component: X for zero; Z for plus. Reduce modulo the original code stabilizers only, not the dangerous logical operator.
derivation.orthogonal_component: Canonical frame maxima are also reported modulo code stabilizers and modulo the prepared-state stabilizers, which additionally include logical Z for zero or X for plus.
